title: On your device
body: Songs stay on your device by default and sync only when you choose an account.

title: Not training data
body: Your melodies and progressions are not used to train models without a separate opt-in.

title: Yours to share
body: Nothing is shared with other users unless you export it. Teachers see counts, not melodies.

title: Yours to delete
body: Songs are kept until you delete them. Deleting an account removes synced copies within thirty days.
